jobs.title: Capability Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for a Capability Manager / Capability Analyst to join the UHC Data & Analytics Office team. In this role, you will help shape and deliver high-impact capabilities that support the growth of the Commercial business within the Enterprise & Individual segment.

You will partner with business, product, and technology teams to understand customer needs, translate them into clear capabilities and requirements, and guide delivery throughout the software development lifecycle. You will play a key role in managing the capability backlog, prioritizing features, supporting release planning, and ensuring solutions deliver meaningful business value.

This opportunity is well suited for someone who enjoys bringing together business needs, product strategy, data, and technology while working collaboratively across diverse teams.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage the capability backlog, including defining, refining, and prioritizing capabilities, features, and user stories
* Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable product requirements and acceptance criteria
* Represent customer and stakeholder perspectives while collaborating with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, Release Train Engineers, and Release Managers
* Help define and communicate the capability vision, priorities, and roadmap
* Lead capability and feature-level grooming, sizing, estimation, and prioritization activities
* Develop and manage release plans in partnership with development and delivery teams
* Provide oversight for risks, issues, dependencies, project documentation, and end-to-end testing activities
* Review delivered capabilities, features, and user stories against established acceptance criteria
* Provide clear and timely updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, issues, and blockers to key stakeholders
* Develop and maintain reporting related to project health, delivery status, resource utilization, and forecasted capacity
* Support Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Identify opportunities to continuously improve delivery processes, collaboration, and business outcomes
* Contribute to an inclusive and collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and teams can effectively deliver shared goals
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Management, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Significant experience in Project Management, Agile Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related technology delivery roles
* Experience supporting medium to large-scale initiatives involving software development and deployment
* Experience translating complex business needs into capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Experience managing or contributing to product/capability backlogs, prioritization, release planning, and delivery
* Experience with relevant product, project, and collaboration tools such as Rally, Aha!, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Clarity, Visio, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Solis understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies and experience applying Agile practices within technology initiatives
* Proven solid analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills
* Proven ability to understand complex business and technology scenarios and communicate them clearly to different audiences
* Proven solid written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology teams
* Proven ability to work across multiple priorities and adapt effectively as business needs evolve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Agile certification such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent
* Experience working within the healthcare or health insurance industry
* Experience with Rally or similar Agile delivery management tools
* Experience with Aha! or comparable product strategy and roadmap tools
* Experience working with Data & Analytics teams or data-driven products and capabilities
* Working knowledge of Power BI and SQL

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management, Technical
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by defining product strategy in ambiguous spaces and building teams that deliver meaningful results at scale? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management - Technical to lead a product management organization at Amazon. In this role, you will own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for a product portfolio that directly impacts how customers experience Amazon's technology. You will set direction in environments where the problem and opportunity may not yet be fully defined, translating complex inputs from customers and stakeholders into a clear, actionable product strategy. Your work will span system design, roadmap prioritization, and cross-functional alignment — all while building and developing a high-performing team of product managers and leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for your portfolio, working backward from customer needs to identify problems worth solving and aligning your roadmap to organizational goals.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers and people leaders, setting the standard for talent development, onboarding, and performance management across your organization.
* Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces by decomposing complex challenges into actionable plans, distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, and making informed trade-offs across opportunity, resources, and sustainability.
* Partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions, integrating generative AI and emerging technologies where they accelerate customer value.
* Establish mechanisms to inspect product quality, operational performance, and customer experience, using data to continuously improve outcomes and communicate progress to senior leadership.

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing a product narrative ahead of a leadership review, sharpening the strategy with your team before presenting to senior stakeholders. Mid-morning, you join a roadmap prioritization session with engineering and science partners, working through trade-offs on upcoming launches. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their career growth and coach them through a challenging stakeholder alignment. Later, you evaluate a proof-of-concept for a new AI-driven feature, assessing feasibility and customer impact before wrapping up with a cross-team sync to unblock a dependency.  
  
About the team  
Our team builds technology products that serve Amazon customers at scale. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where product leaders are empowered to define strategy, experiment with new approaches, and drive meaningful business outcomes. We value thoughtful debate, clear written communication, and a genuine commitment to growing the people around us. We are focused on solving complex problems through innovation and are investing in areas like intelligent automation and generative AI to shape the future of our products. If you are excited about building both great products and great teams, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Manager – Product Delivery & Internal Programs**

**Location:**

Hyderabad – Full-Time, On-Site

**Department:**

Product / Delivery

**Experience:**

3 to 8 years

**Reports To:**

Product / Delivery Leadership

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Project Manager who can bring structure to complexity, move teams from intent to execution, and help shape high-quality product outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, customer delivery, and internal operations. The person will own multiple initiatives end to end, strengthen execution discipline across teams, and contribute meaningfully to roadmap, release, and prioritisation discussions.**

**The ideal candidate combines practical delivery leadership with strong product judgement. They should be comfortable challenging assumptions, probing progress beyond surface-level updates, making trade-offs visible, and ensuring that what is shipped is useful, coherent, reliable, and ready for customers.**

**What You Will Own**

* **End-to-end delivery of product initiatives, customer implementations, and strategic internal projects - from planning and discovery through release, adoption, and closure.**
* **Clear execution plans with defined outcomes, milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and decision points.**
* **Product and engineering delivery across concurrent workstreams, including roadmap coordination, sprint execution, release readiness, and post-release follow-through.**
* **Internal project management practices, including portfolio visibility, leadership reporting, governance rhythms, prioritisation, and cross-functional accountability.**
* **Customer and stakeholder communication, ensuring expectations, risks, trade-offs, and decisions are communicated with clarity and maturity.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Delivery & Roadmap Execution**

**Partner with product and technology leaders to translate business priorities into executable roadmaps, release plans, and delivery sequences.**

**Distinguish between sprint activity and meaningful product progress; keep teams focused on outcomes, not just task completion.**

**Facilitate prioritisation using customer value, business impact, technical effort, regulatory needs, risk, and learning value.**

**Ensure features have clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, release expectations, and measurable success indicators.**

**Protect product coherence by surfacing weak requirements, avoidable complexity, conflicting priorities, and quality risks early.**

**2. Engineering Execution & Release Governance**

**Drive sprint planning, backlog readiness, reviews, demos, retrospectives, and release checkpoints with strong follow-through.**

**Validate progress through working demos, delivery evidence, test results, defect trends, code/release signals, and environment readiness—not narrative status alone.**

**Coordinate engineering, QA, product, design, DevOps, implementation, and customer teams to remove bottlenecks and maintain delivery momentum.**

**Own release readiness across scope, quality, security, documentation, deployment, rollback, training, and stakeholder sign-off.**

**Track and improve delivery health using relevant metrics such as predictability, cycle time, throughput, defect leakage, deployment frequency, and escaped defects.**

**3. Internal Project & Portfolio Management**

**Create a simple, reliable operating system for internal projects, including plans, review cadences, dashboards, RAID logs, decision records, and escalation paths.**

**Provide leadership with a consolidated view of priorities, progress, delivery confidence, product health, risks, resource constraints, and decisions required.**

**Improve planning and execution practices across teams without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.**

**Drive closure on internal initiatives that span product, engineering, operations, marketing, compliance, and customer delivery.**

**Identify recurring execution gaps and convert them into practical process, tooling, ownership, or governance improvements.**

**4. Customer & Stakeholder Leadership**

**Lead customer-facing project communication, reviews, demos, requirement discussions, change control, and milestone sign-offs.**

**Present risks, trade-offs, delays, and recovery plans with honesty, precision, and executive-level clarity.**

**Balance customer commitments with product sustainability, technical quality, and long-term roadmap priorities.**

**Handle escalations with composure, establish facts quickly, and drive clear ownership and resolution.**

**Build trust by being responsive, prepared, and consistent while avoiding over-commitment.**

**5. Risk, Quality & Compliance Awareness**

**Maintain active oversight of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and compliance-sensitive activities.**

**Ensure appropriate controls around access, approvals, audit trails, customer data, release governance, secure delivery, and evidence retention.**

**Work closely with QA and engineering to ensure test coverage, acceptance evidence, defect closure, and production readiness.**

**Anticipate delivery and operational risks early and create credible mitigation or recovery plans.**

**6. Team Leadership & Accountability**

**Create clarity on who owns what, by when, and to what standard.**

**Challenge weak commitments constructively and help teams convert ambiguity into action.**

**Navigate disagreements across business, product, and technology teams while protecting the larger outcome.**

**Coach team members on planning, communication, documentation, estimation, and execution discipline.**

**Lead through influence, sound judgement, preparation, and consistency.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**Leadership has a clear and reliable view of what is on track, what is at risk, why it matters, and what decision is needed.**

**Product releases are better planned, better validate…

jobs.description:
**Description**
The Sr. Product Manager-Tech on the DSP-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end-to-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000+ Delivery Associates.
  
  
This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
  
  
We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.
  
  
This is a global role requiring cross-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
  
  
We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Leading the build-out of new external facing applications, products, features and tools.
* Owning the translation of business intent, customer needs, and/or technical direction into clear, concise, well-documented business requirements or product backlog for one or more complex applications (or a product family) spanning one or more technical domains.
* Developing longer-term (12 months or more) product roadmap, ensuring product development plans align with and support stakeholder business and application objectives.
* Communicate and collaborate cross-functionally across multiple teams in operations, technology and planning to define strategic roadmaps while keeping the impact of the solution to all stakeholders in mind
* Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network
* Monitoring KPI’s to analyze their drivers and determine the level of investment needed

**About The Team**
The team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Arcesium seeks a Product Lead with deep private credit expertise to build and evolve our Private Credit capabilities. This is an individual contributor role, working closely with Engineering, Client & Partner Development, Sales, and Marketing. The product spans the deal-close and post-close lifecycle, including deal onboarding, portfolio monitoring, covenant and borrowing-base management, loan administration, reporting, and related workflows.

jobs.title: Product Owner III
jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

  

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

  

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

  

As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.

  

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
  
* Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
  
* Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
  
* As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
  
  

  
**Qualifications:**
  

  
* Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred

**Category Manager – Travel Business**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
6–12 years

**About Thrillophilia**

Thrillophilia is one of India’s leading experiential travel platforms, helping millions of travellers discover and book curated holidays and experiences across India and international destinations.

We are building destination-led travel businesses where each category is managed with clear ownership across product, pricing, suppliers, marketing, sales, customer experience, revenue, and profitability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

This is not a procurement-only or operations-only role.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

A strong Category Manager should be able to say:

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**What You Will Own**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Create clear product USPs that make the category easier to sell and harder to replicate.
* Ensure the product portfolio serves different customer segments, budgets, and travel styles.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality suppliers, hotels, DMCs, transport partners, and experience providers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, CRM, and Brand teams.
* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

**Customer Experience**

* Track customer feedback, NPS, complaints, cancellations, and service failures.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.
* Identify recurring issues and fix them at the product or supplier level.
* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in category management, business ownership, travel product management, P&L management, or a related role.
* Experience in travel, consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, hospitality, or a high-growth business.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, margins, pricing, and profitability.
* Ability to analyse market demand and translate insights into products and business decisions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
* High ownership and comfort working across multiple teams.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience owning a destination, category, geography, or business line.
* Experience in outbound or domestic holiday packages.
* Exposure to sales-led or high-consideration customer journeys.
* Experience managing both product and commercial outcomes.
* MBA or equivalent business education is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Category revenue
* Contribution margin and profitability
* Booking conversion
* Product performance
* Supplier competitiveness
* Customer satisfaction and NPS
* Cancellation and refund rates
* Sales productivity
* New product success
* Market share growth

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:

* Build a clear understanding of the assigned destination or category.
* Identify the biggest gaps in product, pricing, suppliers, and conversion.
* Create a structured category growth plan.
* Improve product quality, supplier competitiveness, and sales readiness.
* Establish clear performance dashboards and operating reviews.

Over time, you should build and scale the category into a significant, profitable business with strong customer trust and clear market differentiation.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Python Developer (FastAPI + React + Automation) – GST SaaS Platform
jobs.description:
**Company:** Nylun Global Private Limited  
**Product:** GST Software, a GST compliance and business software (SaaS) for businesses and CA firms  
**Location:** Hyderabad (work from office)  
**Experience:** 2–3 years  
**Salary:** ₹3,00,000 – ₹6,00,000 per annum (based on skills and experience)  
**Employment type:** Full-time, permanent

**About us**

Nylun Global Private Limited is building **GST Software**, a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India.

**Where we are today:** the core modules are built as an advanced working prototype. We are now building the **cloud SaaS platform**:

* a modern **React** web app
* a **FastAPI** backend
* a **PostgreSQL** database
* a small, secure **Windows agent** that connects to the cloud and runs automated tasks on the customer’s own computer

More products will follow, including audit and accounting software.

This is the best stage to join: you will help build a SaaS product from the ground up and see it go live.

**Who we are looking for**

We want a young, energetic, hands-on developer who is:

* **hungry for an opportunity** to prove themselves on a real product, not just maintain old code
* **ambitious to grow** with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility
* **passionate about technology, automation and AI**, always learning new tools and better ways of working
* **an owner**, who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks
* **a team player**, happy to help and guide interns and freshers

If you have the skills and the fire to grow, and you want a place where your work is seen, valued and rewarded, this role is for you.

**What you will do**

* **Build the SaaS backend in FastAPI:** a modular monolith with clean REST APIs and OpenAPI documentation.
* **Build the React frontend** (Vite): fast, clean and easy-to-use screens, reports and dashboards.
* **Design PostgreSQL databases:** good data models, efficient queries and indexing for large data.
* **Build a multi-tenant system:** each customer’s data kept separate, with user roles and permissions, secure login and sessions.
* **Background jobs with Redis:** queues for long-running tasks such as imports, processing and report generation.
* **File storage:** store and serve documents and data files using S3-compatible object storage.
* **Build the Windows agent:** a Python tray application that connects securely to the cloud over WebSockets, receives jobs and sends back results.
* **Browser automation** with Selenium or Playwright:
* reliable automation of multi-step web workflows, with proper handling of sessions, timeouts, errors and retries
* always secure, and respecting each website’s rules
* **Packaging and updates:** build Windows installers for the agent and support automatic updates.
* **Admin and internal tools:** an operations admin panel for support, subscriptions and monitoring.
* **Quality:** automated tests (pytest), proper error handling, logging, code reviews, clean Git practice.
* **Use AI every day:** AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, to build faster, with the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code.
* **Work with our Chartered Accountants** to turn business requirements into accurate, working features.
* **Help guide interns and freshers** on daily tasks and code.

**Must-have skills**

* 2–3 years of hands-on software development experience.
* **Strong Python with FastAPI.** Experience with Flask or Django also counts.
* **React** (with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS).
* **PostgreSQL:** good SQL, table design, joins, indexes.
* **REST API design:** authentication (JWT/sessions), validation, error handling.
* **Browser automation:** hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright.
* **Git**, and writing clean, readable code.
* **AI-first working:** daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster.
* Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus.

**Strong plus**

* Redis, and background job queues (Celery, RQ, ARQ, RabbitMQ or similar).
* WebSockets and async Python (asyncio).
* Multi-tenant SaaS: customer-level data separation, roles and permissions.
* Windows desktop or tray apps, and packaging Python apps (PyInstaller, Nuitka, Inno Setup, MSI).
* Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), deployment to Linux, AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Automated testing with pytest.
* S3 or other object storage.

**Good to have**

* GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience.
* Payment gateway integration (Razorpay), email and SMS services, Google sign-in (OAuth).
* Vite, React Query, Tailwind CSS or similar modern frontend tools.
* Node.js or another backend language.

**No GST knowledge? No problem.** Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn.

**What we are NOT looking for**

* Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job.
* Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it.
* Someone who builds automation that works once and breaks often.
* Someone who wants to restart everything from scratch. We build carefully on the work already done.

**Why join Nylun Global Private Limited**

* **Build a SaaS product from the ground up** and see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India.
* **A real opportunity to prove yourself:** your work directly shapes the product.
* **Fast growth:** a clear path to Senior Developer and Lead roles for people who perform.
* **Modern stack:** FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, automation, cloud and AI tools.
* **AI-first culture:** work the way modern engineering teams work.
* **Learning:** learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants.
* **Work directly with the founders**, not through layers of management.
* **Competitive salary:** ₹3–6 lakh per annum based on skills and experience, with performance-based growth.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

**Job Purpose**

Provide technical leadership for the data engineering architecture and delivery of Digital Mobility Products. Design and evolve scalable, reliable and secure data platforms and pipelines that enable product analytics, data science and production AI. Translate product and platform objectives into reusable data solutions, establish engineering and governance standards, and mentor engineers to deliver trusted data, efficient operations and measurable product outcomes in collaboration with product, data science, engineering and DevOps teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Define and evolve data architecture and the data engineering roadmap aligned with Digital Mobility product, platform, analytics and AI priorities.  
2. Design and deliver scalable batch and streaming pipelines to ingest, transform and serve mobility-product data for operational and analytical use cases.  
3. Develop reusable data models, curated datasets and interfaces that support product insights, experimentation and production AI adoption.  
4. Establish data quality checks, validation, metadata and lineage practices to ensure trusted, discoverable and traceable data.  
5. Embed access controls, privacy, security and retention requirements in data solutions; support governance reviews and risk remediation.  
6. Own pipeline observability, reliability and performance; define service levels, resolve incidents and prevent recurrence through root-cause analysis.  
7. Optimize platform performance, scalability and resource consumption through architecture reviews, capacity planning and cost-aware engineering.  
8. Drive automated testing, version control, deployment automation and consistent engineering standards with software engineering and DevOps teams.  
9. Partner with product owners, data scientists and business stakeholders to prioritize delivery, agree acceptance criteria and demonstrate product value.  
10. Provide hands-on technical guidance, review designs and code, mentor engineers, and build reusable patterns and shared data engineering capability.

**Role: Data and Information Architect**

**Experience:** 8+ Years  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India - **Onsite**   
**Domain:** US Healthcare   
**Background:** SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, MSBI

**Role Summary**

  

We are looking for a Data and Information Architect to work **onsite in Chennai** and design enterprise data architecture for US Healthcare clients. The role blends hands-on SQL / MSBI expertise with architecture, modeling, and governance - building scalable platforms for Claims, Membership, Provider, Clinical, and Financial data while ensuring HIPAA compliance and reporting accuracy.

You will be the onsite architecture owner in Chennai, working directly with US-based stakeholders, and leading the offshore data engineering team.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Data Architecture & Design - Onsite Ownership**

* Own end-to-end Data Architecture from Chennai office - Data Warehouse, Data Lake / Lakehouse, ODS, Data Marts for US Healthcare
* Define Enterprise Data Model - Conceptual / Logical / Physical models for Claims, Eligibility, Membership, Provider, Encounter, Clinical
* Design data integration architecture using SSIS, SQL Server, and modern ETL/ELT patterns
* Define data standards, naming conventions, data lineage, and metadata management
* Architect solutions for large-scale, high-volume batch processing

  

**2. US Healthcare Domain**

* Work with HIPAA, PHI/PII, HL7, FHIR, EDI X12 (837P/I, 835, 834, 270/271), ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, NDC, HEDIS, CMS
* Design solutions for Claims Adjudication, Enrollment, Provider Network, Utilization Management, Risk Adjustment (HCC), Quality Measures
* Ensure HIPAA, HITRUST, and CMS compliance in data storage, access, masking, and auditing

  

**3. ETL / Data Integration - SSIS & SQL**

* Architect and review complex SSIS packages, Stored Procedures, and data pipelines for Claims and Clinical data
* Design Data Validation, Reconciliation, and Data Quality frameworks - claim counts, paid amounts, member counts, source-to-target balancing
* Optimize SQL Server performance - Indexing, Partitioning, Query Tuning for multi-million row datasets
* Design Job Monitoring, Scheduling, Error Handling, and Automation for daily / weekly / monthly healthcare cycles

  

**4. Reporting & Analytics Architecture**

* Architect reporting solutions using SSRS, Power BI, iReport for operational, financial, and regulatory reporting
* Define semantic models, KPIs - PMPM, Utilization Rate, Denial Rate, Readmission Rate, STAR Ratings, HEDIS Compliance
* Design governed data marts and self-service BI for business users
* Ensure report accuracy through reconciliation and audit trails

  

**5. Data Governance, Security & Production Support**

* Define Data Governance - Data Ownership, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM) for Member / Provider / Payer
* Design role-based access, data masking, encryption, and audit logging for PHI data
* Provide L3 architectural support for production issues - performance, data discrepancies, job failures
* Lead Root Cause Analysis and implement long-term fixes

  

**6. Onsite Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Work onsite in Chennai as Lead Architect, leading design reviews, architecture boards, and mentoring developers
* Collaborate daily with US Product Owners, Business Analysts, Compliance, and QA teams
* Create Architecture Diagrams, HLD/LLD, Data Flow Diagrams, and Solution Blueprints
* Coordinate onsite-offshore delivery and ensure SLA adherence

  

**Technical Skills Required**

**Core:**

* SQL Server, MySQL, T-SQL - Advanced Stored Procedures, Performance Tuning
* SSIS - Enterprise ETL Design, SSRS - Report Development, MSBI Stack
* Data Modeling - Erwin / ER Studio / Visio, Dimensional Modeling, Data Vault

**Healthcare:**

* HL7, FHIR, EDI X12, ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS
* Claims, Membership, Provider, Clinical Data
* HIPAA, HEDIS, CMS, Risk Adjustment

**Good to Have:**

* Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, Power BI
* Python, HTML, iReport / JasperReports
* Job Scheduling - SQL Agent, Control-M, Autosys
* Production Support (L2/L3), Data Validation & Reconciliation

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field
* 8+ years in SQL Server, ETL, Reporting, with 3+ years in US Healthcare data architecture

The Data Research Specialist is an individual contributor role that develops deep proficiency in a niche dataset / workflow and owns the end-to-end data lifecycle for one or more datasets —from sourcing and rule design through validation, enrichment, delivery, and handover. Specialists maintain and evolve rule books and SOPs, provide UAT inputs, participate in solutioning, and begin direct interactions with vendors and internal partners. * Awareness of internal platforms and data ecosystems (e.g., data lakes, workflow engines).

* Strong understanding of US GAAP financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement) and their interrelationships

* Ability to analyze and interpret financial disclosures, footnotes, and management commentary

* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with large and complex financial datasets

* Ability to resolve complex tickets and client queries independently.

* Support definition and refinement of data KPIs and control checks.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, with comfort navigating ambiguity within defined scope.

* Clear communication and ability to collaborate and influence within the assigned dataset or domain.

* Ownership mindset with ability to work with limited supervision and maintain disciplined documentation.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with 7+ years of overall experience and a strong technical foundation in Database Administration (DBA) or Data Engineering, followed by experience in Data Governance or Data Stewardship.

The ideal candidate should combine strong business analysis capabilities with practical knowledge of Oracle and PostgreSQL databases, including database privileges, access controls and auditing.

* Conduct data governance assessments and workshops with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technical teams.

* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to define data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, governance policies and standards.
* Work with DBA and Data Engineering teams to understand Oracle and PostgreSQL database environments, privileges, roles and auditing mechanisms.
* Analyse database access controls, user privileges and audit requirements and translate business needs into functional requirements.
* Support metadata management, data lineage, data quality and data stewardship initiatives.
* Work with Collibra, Informatica or Alation to support governance workflows, metadata documentation and stewardship activities.
* Prepare BRDs, FRDs, process flows, assessment reports, functional specifications and requirement traceability documents.
* Coordinate with technical teams to validate governance requirements and ensure successful implementation.
* Track governance issues, risks, action items and remediation activities.
* Support audit readiness and regulatory compliance through appropriate governance documentation and evidence.

**Mandatory Skills**

1. **Overall Experience:**
   7+ years, ideally beginning as a DBA or Data Engineer and subsequently transitioning into Data Governance or Data Stewardship.
2. **Business Analysis:**
   Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, workshops, assessments, gap analysis and documentation.
3. **Database Knowledge:**
   Hands-on experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL.
4. **Database Security:**
   Practical understanding of database privileges, roles, access controls and auditing.
5. **Data Governance Tools:**
   Experience with at least one of the following:

* Collibra
* Informatica
* Alation

1. **Data Governance:**
   Knowledge of data ownership, data stewardship, metadata management, data lineage and data quality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to GxP, regulatory compliance and audit requirements.
* Experience conducting enterprise data governance assessments.
* Ability to work with DBA, Data Engineering, Security, Compliance and Business teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A technically strong Business Analyst who started their career as a DBA or Data Engineer and transitioned into Data Governance or Data Stewardship. The candidate must be capable of understanding database-level controls while independently conducting stakeholder workshops, gathering requirements, performing assessments and translating governance needs into functional specifications.

**Product Manager – Ad Decisioning Enablement**  
  
**Roundel, Target’s Retail Media Network**  
  
**About us**  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  
  
**Team Overview**  
  
Roundel is Target’s retail media network, helping brands connect with millions of Target guests through relevant, measurable, and guest-centered advertising experiences.  
  
As retail media continues to grow, advertisers are looking for smarter ways to plan, activate, optimize, and measure their investments. Roundel is investing in next-generation intelligence products that help teams and advertisers make better media decisions across channels, campaign stages, and business objectives.  
  
We are looking for a **Product Manager** to lead a high-impact area focused on **ad-inventory forecasting** and **ad-relevance** capabilities  
  
In this role, you will shape capabilities that enable our ad-decisioning engine elevate customer experience and deliver advertiser outcomes. This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and building systems that translate complex signals into decision drivers  
  
You will partner closely with data science, engineering, analytics, and product teams to define the strategy, roadmap, and execution for capabilities that help Roundel deliver more effective, and measurable advertising outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll do**

  

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for ad-inventory forecasting and ad-relevance.
* Working at the intersection of data, AI, and business, you’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, and partner teams to design scalable systems and intelligent models.
* Collaborate with sales, GTM and other product teams to ensure these products translate into real-world value for advertisers, and to continuously refine based on adoption, performance, and market feedback.
* As part of Roundel, Target’s retail media business, play a pivotal role in advancing the sophistication of our forecasting, optimization, and recommendation engines.
* Influence how advertisers plan, invest, and win on Target’s platform — impacting both advertiser success and Target’s bottom line.

**What we’re looking for**

  

* Experience: 4+ years of Product Management, ideally with a focus on data-driven, optimization, or AI/ML-powered products in adtech, martech, or related fields.
* Technical fluency: Comfortable working with data science, machine learning, experimentation, or AI-driven systems; able to bridge technical depth with business application.
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of retail media networks, digital advertising ecosystems, or media buying workflows is a strong plus.
* Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to partner with data engineers, scientists, API developers, and commercial teams to bring complex products to market.
* Analytical strength: Skilled at interpreting large datasets, validating accuracy, and turning complex signals into actionable decisions.
* AI curiosity: Experience (or strong interest) in GenAI/agentic AI and applying emerging technologies to improve forecasting, optimization, and recommendations.
* Strategic mindset: Able to set product vision, establish OKRs, and drive execution across multiple dependencies in a fast-moving space.
* Influence & storytelling: Excellent communicator who can distil technical complexity into compelling narratives for sales, advertisers, and executives.
* Organized & adaptable: Adept at managing priorities, navigating ambiguity, and iterating quickly based on feedback and results.
* A bias for action, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a passion for building products that create measurable impact.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Flowy is an AI-native HRMS, founded in 2026, that centralizes HR workflows from hire to retire. The platform is designed to make HR more human by reducing manual, repetitive tasks and streamlining complex processes. Flowy enables HR professionals to spend less time managing systems and more time supporting people across the organization. The product offers a thoughtful, people-first alternative to traditional, feature-heavy HR technology and is focused on delivering intuitive, modern experiences for HR teams and employees.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, remote Product Manager role. The Product Manager will own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and definition to launch and iteration, for key areas of Flowy’s AI-native HR platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting user research with HR teams and employees, defining product requirements and roadmaps, writing clear user stories, and collaborating closely with design, engineering, and data teams to deliver high-quality features. The role involves prioritizing the backlog based on user impact and business goals, monitoring product performance and usage data, and continuously refining the product through experiments and feedback. The Product Manager will also work with go-to-market teams to ensure successful releases, documentation, and stakeholder alignment.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in product management, including defining roadmaps, writing user stories, and managing the product lifecycle in a SaaS or B2B environment.
* Strong skills in user research, requirements gathering, and translating customer pain points into clear, actionable product solutions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, data, and go-to-market functions in a remote setting.
* Comfort with data analysis, experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), and using metrics to inform prioritization and measure product success.
* Familiarity with HR technology, HR processes, or people operations is highly beneficial.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills, with a focus on clarity and inclusion.
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, organize multiple initiatives, and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Data Fabric & Ontology
jobs.description:
**Life at UiPath**
The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
  
  
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
  
  
Could that be you?
  
  
**Your Mission**
Shape the future of agentic automation. UiPath is evolving from RPA to the world’s first Agentic Orchestration platform, enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents at scale. You’ll own one of the foundational layers that power it: Data Fabric and Ontology, the data and context layer that every other product on the platform (agents, workflows, and RPA) depends on to do its job. Your charter is to define where the data layer sits in the agentic stack, make it the obvious and trusted choice for developers and customers, and prove that value with real production adoption.
  
  
This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You won’t be running status meetings. You’ll be deep in the product: building agentic automations, prototyping with coding agents, talking with customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers who build it.
  
  
**The Platform You’ll Shape**
You’ll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath’s agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on. Data Fabric gives agents and workflows governed, real-time access to enterprise data. Ontology models those raw records into business entities and a connected semantic layer that automations can reason and act over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate, and making that context the backbone of how the platform reasons.
  
  
**What You’ll Do At UiPath**

* Own the strategy and positioning for UiPath’s data layer. Set the point of view on what the data layer is and why it matters in the agentic era. Turn that into the narrative leadership, marketing, and the field rally behind.
* Own the vision and roadmap for Data Fabric and Ontology, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
* Drive adoption across every consuming surface. Partner with peer product and engineering teams to make Data Fabric and Ontology the default, and treat internal adoption as seriously as external demand.
* Drive external go-to-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
* Be the customer’s champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
* Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value: production adoption, breadth of connected data sources and entity coverage, consumption across platform surfaces, and query performance and trust.
* Get technical. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
* Make it agent-ready. Translate the fast-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
* Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring, setting the standard for how the platform thinks about data and context.

**What You’ll Bring To The Team**

* 8+ years of product management on technical, platform, or developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Data and semantic depth. Hands-on experience with data platforms and with modeling business objects as entities; familiarity with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or ontologies is a strong advantage.
* A builder’s instinct. You’ve shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you’d rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
* Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
* Hands-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work.
* A strategic narrative. You can define a category and a point of view, and tell a clear “why now” and “why us” story that executives, the field, and customers buy into.
* A genuine customer-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
* GTM drive. You’ve created demand and driven adoption, not just delivered features
* Crisp, decision-rich communication and the ability to influence across engineering, design, sales, and marketing without authority.
* Bias to ownership and action. You take ambiguous, high-stakes problems and drive them to a result with minimal direction.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company:**
Spacewire ech

**Location:**
HSR Layout, Bengaluru

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office (Monday–Friday, 5 Days a Week).
**NO WFH/REMOTE OPTIONS AVAILABLE**

About us

**We build subscription apps for Bharat:**
the hundreds of millions of people in tier 2, 3 and 4 India who pay by UPI and live on their phones. Our apps include BhaktiLok (daily devotion, aartis, AI palm and face reading), MeraTune (ringtones with your own name in them), CashAlert (voice alerts for UPI payments) and HeyBuddy (voice lock and assistant).

We are a small team that ships fast. An idea on Monday is usually a live test by Friday, and the numbers decide who was right.

The role

You will own the path from install to paid subscriber on one or more of our apps: onboarding, paywall, trial, autopay and retention. You work directly with the founders, engineers, designers and the ads team, and you get real ownership from week one — this is a backfill role, so you'll be stepping into live funnels and running experiments from day one, not easing in slowly.

**This is a junior role (6 months to 2 years of experience). We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than about your title so far.**

What you'll do

• Run experiments on onboarding, paywalls, pricing and trials, from hypothesis to result, and call the winner with data.

• Live in Mixpanel: build funnels, spot where users drop, and turn that into the next test.

• Track the subscription numbers that matter: login to trial, trial to paid, autopay success, renewals and churn.

• Write short, clear PRDs and work with engineers and designers to ship them quickly.

• Tear down competitor apps and bring back what is worth testing.

• Work with the ads team so the promise in the ad matches the first screen of the app.

• Shape features around how our users actually behave: regional languages, low-end Android phones, UPI autopay habits.

• Use AI tools every day to move faster on research, specs, copy and analysis.

Who we're looking for

**You should have**

• A feel for consumer apps in India, especially subscription, UPI autopay or content apps for the next billion users.

• Comfort with numbers. You can read a funnel, question it, and explain what it means in two lines.

• Clear writing in English and good spoken Hindi. You should be able to think like a user in Patna as easily as one in Pune.

• A bias to ship. You would rather run a rough test this week than a perfect one next month.

• Curiosity. You install apps just to see how their paywall works.

**Good to have**

• Hands-on time with Mixpanel, Firebase or a similar analytics tool.

• Hands-on experience with UPI AutoPay, mandate flows, recurring billing, or payment retry/dunning logic — big plus given our autopay and D2C payments work.

• Exposure to paywalls, pricing tests, payment gateways (Razorpay, Juspay, etc.) or Meta ads.

• Experience in devotional, astrology, utility or entertainment apps.

• A side project, app, page or channel you grew yourself.

Why you'll like it here

**Real ownership.**
Your tests go live to real users, and you see the result in days.

**Grow with us.**
This is an immediate backfill with real scope from day one — if you own it well, there's a clear path from Associate PM to PM as the product and team grow.

**Learn the full stack of a subscription business.**
Product, pricing, payments, ads and analytics, all in one seat.

**The gear you need.**
Laptop, tools, AI subscriptions: ask and it is sorted.

**We celebrate.**
Team parties every month, and nobody needs a reason.

**No heavy process.**
Few meetings, short docs, quick decisions.

**A fun bunch.**
We take the numbers seriously and ourselves a lot less.

How to apply

Send your resume to hr@spacewiretech.com with two things:

• One app you think has a great paywall or onboarding, and why.

• One thing you would test first on any of our apps.

**Location: HSR Layout, Bengaluru (In Office) · Experience: 6 months to 2 years**

\*\*Job Description – Credit Risk Business Analyst\*\*
  
  
Experience: 3–6 years
  
Type: Full-time
  
Location: Bengaluru (frequent, extended travel to the GCC required)
  
  
\*\*About ALP\*\*
  
Angel Lane Partners (ALP) is a computational finance, data engineering and AI/ML firm with offices in Dubai, London, Bengaluru and Riyadh. We work with banks, financial institutions and government entities across the GCC.
  
  
\*\*Role Overview\*\*
  
You will work on credit risk engagements for GCC banks, including credit approval automation, rating and scoring models, IFRS 9 ECL, early warning and credit risk system implementations. You will own requirements, analysis and testing for one or more modules of an engagement, working directly with the bank's credit, risk and IT teams and with ALP's data engineers, developers and quants. Much of this work is done on site at the client. You will report to a senior BA or engagement lead, and guide junior analysts working on your modules.
  
  
\*\*Travel\*\*
  
This role requires frequent travel to client sites in the GCC, often for long durations of several weeks at a time. Candidates must be willing and able to travel on this basis and must hold a valid passport.
  
  
\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*
  
  
\*Requirements and design\*
  
- Run requirements workshops with credit, risk and IT stakeholders; write BRDs, FSDs and user stories for your modules and take them through client review.
  
- Document as-is and to-be credit processes across origination, appraisal, approval, review, monitoring and remedial management, and identify steps that can be automated.
  
- Translate credit policies, delegated authority matrices and product programmes into business rules for workflow and decision engines.
  
- Contribute to solution design for approval workflows, auto-decision rules, rating and scoring frameworks, IFRS 9 staging and ECL processes, and early warning indicators.
  
- Track regulatory requirements relevant to the engagement (CBUAE, QCB, SAMA, Basel) and reflect them in requirements.
  
  
\*Data and analysis\*
  
- Map source data (customer, facility, collateral, financial statements, ratings, limits) to target data models, and define transformation rules with data engineers.
  
- Run data quality and portfolio analysis in SQL and Python: completeness checks, segmentation, concentration, and reconciliation to finance and risk reports.
  
- Carry out backtesting, rule calibration, override analysis and benefit analysis for credit rules and models, and prepare PD, LGD and EAD inputs.
  
- Build dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or similar for portfolio analysis and engagement reporting.
  
  
\*Testing and delivery\*
  
- Write test scenarios and test cases for your modules; lead SIT, support UAT with client users, and triage defects with developers.
  
- Draft client deliverables, methodology documents, user manuals and training material, and deliver user training.
  
- Report status on your modules, raise risks and issues, and contribute to the project plan and RAID log.
  
- Guide and review the work of junior analysts on your modules.
  
  
\*\*Required Skills\*\*
  
- 3–6 years in credit risk at a bank, consulting firm or risk software vendor.
  
- Hands-on involvement in at least one credit risk system, process automation or model implementation.
  
- Understanding of corporate and retail credit products, the credit lifecycle, collateral and internal rating systems.
  
- Working knowledge of PD, LGD, EAD, IFRS 9 staging and ECL, and Basel capital requirements, and experience applying them in analysis or implementation work.
  
- Coding in SQL and Python for data analysis and validation.
  
- Building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or similar.
  
- Experience running requirements workshops and writing BRDs or FSDs.
  
- Experience planning and executing SIT or UAT.
  
- Willingness to travel frequently to the GCC for long durations.
  
  
\*\*Preferred Skills\*\*
  
  
- Credit risk system or loan origination system implementation at a bank.
  
- Financial statement spreading and credit appraisal.
  
- GCC banking experience or exposure to CBUAE, QCB or SAMA requirements.
  
- Exposure to project planning and RAID management.
  
- Databricks, AWS or Azure.
  
- Certifications in BI, ML, cloud or infrastructure.
  
- FRM or CFA, completed or in progress.
  
  
\*\*Qualifications\*\*
  
- Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics or a related field; a master's, MBA or PhD is preferred.
  
- Clear written English for client-facing documents.
  
- Able to run working sessions with client credit, risk and IT teams.
